name: sim_checkpoint_roundtrip
description: A simulation loaded from a checkpoint taken at tick 2000 or just after, with a cannon shell in the air, reaches the same hash at tick 6000 as the one that kept running, and every hash between: nothing in flight is lost by the codec.

steps.assert: scene.client(1).tick > 2000 and scene.client(1).tick < 2300 and scene.shells_in_flight(1) > 0 and scene.client(1).creeps.size() > 0 and scene.client(1).towers.size() == 3
steps.msg: a frost spire, an arrow tower and a partner's cannon fight a wave on the road, and a cannon shell is in the air
deserialize(serialize()) gives back the same bytes
and every field of every record, the shell's burst point too: nothing the codec leaves out on both sides
both reach the same hash at tick 6000
and at every hash tick between
